name: com.mystarletter/human-design-chart
title: My Star Letter: charts and compatibility
description: Human Design, birth chart, Life Path, BaZi, Saju, Saturn return, astrocartography and compatibility.

tools.name: get_human_design_chart
tools.description: Calculate a Human Design chart: type, strategy, authority, profile, definition, centers and channels, with approved plain-English texts and a link to their chart card. Use when someone asks "what's my Human Design", "am I a Generator or a Projector", "what's my authority / profile", or shares a birthday and wants their design. The positions come from an ephemeris checked against the Swiss Ephemeris, so never guess a type from memory. birth_time is optional: without it the chart is worked out for every half hour of the day and the result says which parts depend on the time. time_zone is the IANA zone of the birthplace.

birth_time.description: Local birth time, 24-hour HH:MM. Leave out if unknown.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone of the birthplace, e.g. America/Chicago or Europe/London.

tools.name: get_human_design_compatibility
tools.description: Compare two people's Human Design charts: sparks (channels each completes for the other), shared channels, who sets the tone, centers they define only together, and how one's Venus meets the other's Mars, as short plain lines with a link to the free compatibility page. Use when someone asks "are we compatible in Human Design", "our Human Design together", or names two types and wants to know how they work. Exact charts from the same ephemeris as the site, not a guess from type names. Birth times and places are optional; without them the result says what can change. "you" is the person asking, "them" the other. Takes birth details only, never names or contact details, and stores nothing. It describes tendencies for reflection, never a verdict on whether a relationship will work or last.

tools.name: get_birth_chart
tools.description: Calculate a natal astrology chart: Sun, Moon and rising sign (the big three), Venus, Mars, Saturn and North Node signs, each with a short approved meaning, plus a link to the matching free tool page. Use when someone asks "what's my rising sign", "my big three", "what's my Moon sign", "my Venus sign", "my birth chart" or "what sign is my Mars in". Positions come from an ephemeris checked against the Swiss Ephemeris, so never guess a sign from a birthday alone. birth_time and birth_place are optional: without the time the Moon may show two possible signs and there is no rising sign; the rising sign needs the time and a listed birthplace (or latitude and longitude).

tools.name: get_saturn_return
tools.description: Find when a person's Saturn returns happen: every date transiting Saturn reaches their birth Saturn degree from age 20 to 95 (often two or three passes per return), their Saturn sign and its approved meaning, and a link to the free Saturn return page. Use when someone asks "when is my Saturn return", "am I in my Saturn return" or "what age is my second Saturn return". The dates are searched in an ephemeris checked against the Swiss Ephemeris, which cannot be done by hand. birth_time and the birthplace are optional; without them the dates use noon and can move by a day or two.

tools.name: get_north_node
tools.description: Find a person's North Node sign (and the South Node opposite), what it grows toward and the old habit it moves away from, in approved plain words, with a link to the free North Node calculator. With birth time and a listed birthplace it adds the exact degree and the house. Use when someone asks "what's my North Node", "my South Node", "my life direction in astrology" or "my karmic path". Uses the site's crossing table and ephemeris (checked against the Swiss Ephemeris), not a memory of dates. Birth dates 1930 to 2031. Without a birth time the result says when the sign changed that day.

Use when someone asks "are we compatible", "our synastry", "compatibility by birthday", "is my Venus good with their Mars" or names two signs and wants a match. Exact aspects from an ephemeris checked against the Swiss Ephemeris, not sign stereotypes. Times and places are optional for both; without them aspects that depend on the time are marked and the Ascendant is left out. Takes birth details only, never names or contact details, and stores nothing. It describes tendencies for reflection, never a verdict on whether a relationship will work or last.

tools.name: get_astrocartography
tools.description: Map where on Earth a person's ten planet lines fall (MC, IC, rising and setting lines), the line closest to their birthplace, and which lines run within 700 km of up to five places they name, each with an approved plain meaning and a link to the free astro map. Use when someone asks "where should I live astrologically", "my astro map", "astrocartography", "my Venus line" or "is Lisbon good for me". Lines come from an ephemeris checked against the Swiss Ephemeris and move about 1,000 miles per hour of birth time, so this needs an exact birth time and birthplace. Put the cities to check in places.

tools.name: get_life_path_number
tools.description: Work out a numerology Life Path number from a birth date, keeping the master numbers 11, 22 and 33, with each step of the sum, the number's name and its approved plain meaning, and a link to the free Life Path page. Use when someone asks "what's my life path number", "my numerology number" or "am I a master number". Doing the sum this way avoids the common slip of adding all digits at once, which loses master numbers. Only the birth date is needed.

tools.name: get_life_path_compatibility
tools.description: Compare two people's numerology Life Path numbers from their birth dates: both numbers with each step of the sum and their approved meanings, then how the two styles meet, how the numbers relate (same number, the groups 1-5-7, 2-4-8 and 3-6-9, master numbers read with their root) and one gentle balance line, with a link to the free Life Path page. Use when someone asks "are our life path numbers compatible", "life path compatibility", "numerology compatibility" or "my life path 7 and their 3". The sums keep the master numbers 11, 22 and 33, which adding all digits at once loses. Only the two birth dates are needed. Takes birth details only, never names or contact details, and stores nothing. It describes tendencies for reflection, never a verdict on whether a relationship will work or last.

tools.name: get_bazi_chart
tools.description: Calculate a Chinese BaZi chart: the year, month, day and hour pillars (heavenly stems and earthly branches with Chinese characters and pinyin), the Day Master, the five elements count, the year animal, with approved plain meanings and a link to the free BaZi page. Use when someone asks "my BaZi", "four pillars of destiny", "my Day Master", "what element am I" or "my Chinese zodiac element". Month and year change at exact solar terms (Li Chun, not January 1), found with an ephemeris. birth_time is optional: without it the chart has three pillars and the result says so.
